triggerCases.prompt: Create a project-local verification skill for this repo and prove its instructions once.
Package our CLI launch, behavior checks, evidence capture, and cleanup as a reusable local skill for future agents.
Run the existing tests and tell me whether they pass.
Review whether these tests prove the intended behavior. Do not create or edit files.
Maintain the existing verify-taskbook skill and correct its outdated recipes.

outputCases.prompt: Create a local verification skill for Taskbook using the supplied project fixture. Prove it once and preserve the evidence after cleanup. Do not commit or publish anything.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A portable project-local skill and feature map grounded in the actual CLI, with a successful user-path proof and retained evidence.
assertions: The subject copies the executable project fixture to a disposable workspace and preserves its product files and existing project-notes skill.
The generated skill uses the documented .agents/skills layout, portable name and description frontmatter, and no global install or duplicate vendor copies.
The generated instructions contain actual supported commands, read-only doctor checks, isolated data, evidence capture, and cleanup without requiring a PTY or invented tools.
The feature map describes add and list behavior, including a public read that proves an added task persisted.
The subject executes the generated instructions for at least one mapped feature and retains command, output, and exit-status evidence outside removed scratch data.
The report distinguishes the executed proof from total mapped coverage and makes no commit, push, PR, or scheduling claim.

outputCases.prompt: Generate the desktop project's verification skill from these inspected facts. Do not install tools or fix the app.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: Draft instructions with an explicit execution blocker, without fabricated validation or out-of-scope repairs.
assertions: The subject labels any generated skill a draft and identifies the unsupported operating system and unavailable desktop driver.
The response states which launch, drive, evidence, and cleanup steps remain unverified and does not claim successful execution.
The subject does not modify product code, install dependencies or tools, change agent configuration, or publish anything.
